suite.title: Mediation stress test
suite.note: Exploratory analysis: the run was shortened after inspecting initial results. Each setting and mechanism has 14–15 simulated tables; coverage and rankings are uncertain.
suite.summaryNote: Summary metrics pool 480 tables across 11 settings and 3 mechanisms, weighted by table counts. RMSE is the square root of the pooled mean squared error. Related settings and mechanisms reuse underlying draws.
suite.sourceNote: Reference mechanism follows the shared stress-test design based on Tchetgen Tchetgen and Shpitser (2012), Section 3. Smooth and threshold are additional outcome mechanisms.

settings.label: Weak overlap 10%
settings.description: Target 10% of the population with propensity below 0.05 or above 0.95.

settings.label: Weak overlap 20%
settings.description: Target 20% of the population with propensity below 0.05 or above 0.95.

settings.label: Weak overlap 30%
settings.description: Target 30% of the population with propensity below 0.05 or above 0.95.

settings.label: Outcome noise 1.5×
settings.description: Outcome residual standard deviation 1.5 times the reference.

settings.label: Outcome noise 2.5×
settings.description: Outcome residual standard deviation 2.5 times the reference.

settings.label: Outcome noise 4×
settings.description: Outcome residual standard deviation 4 times the reference.

settings.label: Sample size 250
settings.description: Use a 250-row subsample of the 500-row reference table.

mechanisms.label: Reference
mechanisms.description: Reference outcome mechanism from the shared stress-test design.

mechanisms.label: Smooth interaction
mechanisms.description: Additional outcome mechanism with a centered smooth treatment–mediator interaction.

mechanisms.label: Threshold interaction
mechanisms.description: Additional outcome mechanism with a centered threshold treatment–mediator interaction.

Binary mediator.
Continuous outcome.
